QuestInfo.name: Cucumber Dessert
QuestInfo.0: After her previous failure of innovation, #p9120005# in Showa Town is thinking of developing a new product with a greater focus on taste.
QuestInfo.1:
So my Bitter Cucumber didn't sell. If I'm honest, it tasted awful. But I have a new plan! A novelty dessert calld Cucumelon. All I need to make it is #t2012001# and #t04000223#. Will you help me gather them? 
 
#t2012001#   #c2012001#/10 
#t4000223#   #c4000223#/200
QuestInfo.2: A surprisingly tasty union of honey and fresh cucumber, this new product might actually sell.

0.0: It tastes terrible! Even if it's for your health, no one will buy a food that taste terrible.
0.1: If I don't do better, my business will surely go under. I have to create a product that tastes good. Maybe even a dessert! Can I count on your help again?

yes.0: I've come this far. I should see this to the finish. My comeback plan is to create a healthy dessert targeted at young women.
yes.1: I discovered that if you sprinkle #t2012001# on a \r\n#t4000223#, it makes a snack that is sweet and tasty.
yes.2: I call it the Cucumelon, and I know it will sell like hotcakes!
yes.3: Please bring me #t2012001# x10 and #t4000223# x200!

no.0: In business, there are no second chances. I guess I have to get used to being a failure.

1.0: That was fast! It looks like you brought me everything I asked for. I'm sure with my skills and these ingredients, my new dish will be a success. Please accept this small gift.
1.1: My test batch is quite good. I'm sure this will bring me lots of business.

item.0: Oh no, I'll need more than this to make a fantastic dessert.
